answer: The vertex holds work receipts rather than names, so the shale of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, diluted when peers disagree. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. What survives to the voyage is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
